name: THE HOOD
description: As the Hood, Parker Robbins is treading the dangerous path toward the throne of the criminal underworld. Cloaked in a cursed mantle, he devours the firepower of his foes, feeding his own dark might. When he transforms into his full demonic state, a torrent of dark magic sweeps over all who stand in his way!
lore: Parker Robbins' faith in heroes died along with his world's Captain America, replaced by an appetite for power and the will to take it. After stealing an enchanted cloak from the Vault, Parker tapped into its vast power to remake himself as the crime lord called The Hood. Never truly knowing if he's pulling the strings or if it's all part of Oblivion's plan, he was sent to Thebes to steal the Tablet of Death and Entropy. Despite cutting down master thief Gambit, The Hood lost his master's prize when Doom 2099 seized it from the shadows.

abilities.name: Accursed Pistols
abilities.description: Shoot forward dual-wielded pistols. Gain increased Attack Speed when Demonic Energy exceeds 50%

stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 8m, decreasing to 55% at 20m

abilities.name: Leaded Transformation
abilities.description: Enter Half-Demon State, transforming your arms into demonic rifles to unleash a rain of lead. These rifles have increased Attack Speed and Infinite Ammo. Every bullet that strikes an enemy triggers Lifesteal

stats.Bullet Spread Radius: Spread radius reaches 0.5m after 10 consecutive shots (calculated at 10m distance)
stats.Damage Falloff: Falloff begins at 8m, decreasing to 80% at 20m

abilities.name: Mantle of Oblivion
abilities.description: Spread your cloak to form a spherical barrier, blocking incoming enemy attacks. When Demonic Energy exceeds 50%, the radius of the sphere expands further.

abilities.name: Abyssal Veil
abilities.description: Throw a dark magic sphere that generates a Veil upon landing. Accursed Pistols shots passing through it generate more Demonic Energy and bullets from Leaded Transformation gain increased Lifesteal. Enemy projectiles passing through suffer reduced damage and healing output. Enemies who pass through the Veil take damage and are Blinded

abilities.name: Void Walk
abilities.description: Enter the Void for free-flight. Upon reappearing, gain a decaying Movement Boost and damage surrounding enemies

stats.Movement Boost: 40% during the Ability, decaying to 0% over 2s after it ends

abilities.name: Ruinous Pact
abilities.description: Accumulate Demonic Energy by dealing damage via Accursed Pistols, blocking attacks with Mantle of Oblivion, or by using Void Walk. Reaching full energy automatically triggers the Half-Demon State

abilities.name: Demon of the End
abilities.description: Enter Full Demon State. Fire up to 6 high-powered shots that pierce through enemies and barriers, with the final shot being the most powerful. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health to yourself and nearby allies

base.description: Gain a New Ability. Create an arcane zone that continuously damages enemies and applies stacking Damage and Healing Reduction. Reactivate to teleport to the zone's center.

enhanced.description: When teaming up with Scarlet Witch, after teleporting, unleash a magical shockwave, dealing one-time damage to nearby enemies while launching them towards The Hood

base.description: Enhances Abyssal Veil into a Lunar Barrier that blocks projectiles. Upon breaking, it detonates, damaging enemies and applying Damage and Healing Reduction. Enemies passing through take damage and are briefly Blinded.

enhanced.description: When teaming up with Moon Knight, the Lunar Barrier has greater shield value, and The Hood's attacks that pass through it gain a bounce effect
